Team Rocket Returns

Released November 1, 2004 · 111 cards

Team Rocket Returns is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on November 1, 2004. Its main set has 109 cards, plus 2 secret rares numbered beyond the set (111 in total). It includes 97 Pokémon, 12 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

24 illustrators worked on Team Rocket Returns. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (10), Ryo Ueda (9), Kouki Saitou (7), Nakaoka (7), Atsuko Nishida (6), Masakazu Fukuda (6), Kagemaru Himeno (5), Katsura Tabata (5).
